preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of elements in the sequence is between 1 and 10^4, inclusive.
Each element in the sequence B is between 1 and its index, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if it is possible to obtain the sequence A = B or 'NO' if it is impossible.
